terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.summary: Rules for using the non-profit AZIB platform for easier marriage.

scope.heading: Scope of service
scope.body: The platform is non-profit and charges no commissions or subscriptions. It offers no dating services and no partner search; choosing a spouse is the families' responsibility alone.

accounts.heading: Accounts
accounts.body: You must provide accurate information at sign-up. You are responsible for keeping your password secret and for all activity under your account.

conduct.heading: Acceptable use
conduct.body: Impersonation, abusive content, and attempts to access other beneficiaries' data are prohibited. Violations may lead to suspension after human review.

liability.heading: Limitation of liability
liability.body: The platform is an organizing intermediary: it holds no funds and guarantees no application outcome. Monetary donations happen outside the app through a licensed provider.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.summary: How we collect, protect, and expose your data.

collection.heading: What we collect
collection.body: Display name, email, approximate location, and application data when you submit one. We never collect payment card data.

use.heading: How we use it
use.body: To run your account, review eligibility, and contact you about your request. We never sell data or use it for advertising.

sharing.heading: Who can see it
sharing.body: There are no public individual profiles. Beneficiary data is restricted to authorized roles on a strict minimum basis.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.body: You can export your data, edit your profile, withdraw optional consents, and request account deletion with a cancellable confirmation period.

eligibility.title: Eligibility policy
eligibility.summary: How assistance requests are reviewed and who decides.

basis.heading: Basis of eligibility
basis.body: Eligibility rests on documented need and supporting evidence. Income bands and eligibility thresholds are human decisions not yet approved.

review.heading: Human review
review.body: Automated scoring is advisory only; it neither grants nor blocks a right. The final decision belongs to a human reviewer who records a reason.

appeal.heading: Appeals
appeal.body: You may appeal a decision within a window to be set by the owner. Appeals are reviewed by an independent committee.

weddings-withdrawal.title: Group wedding withdrawal policy
weddings-withdrawal.summary: Registration, withdrawal, and financial impact rules.

registration.heading: Registration
registration.body: Registering for a group wedding is free and creates no payment obligation to the platform. Seats are limited and assigned after human verification.

withdrawal.heading: Withdrawal
withdrawal.body: You may withdraw before a defined deadline. The final withdrawal policy (notice period and priority impact) awaits a human decision.

costs.heading: Costs
costs.body: The platform does not cover external costs on your behalf and collects no fees. Any partner contribution is documented separately.

souk.title: Souk Khair policy
souk.summary: Rules for in-kind donations between families.

donations.heading: In-kind donations
donations.body: Souk Khair is for physical items only. No money inside the app, no wallet, and no internal transfer.

safety.heading: Safety
safety.body: Hand over items in a public place and verify their condition before accepting. Contact details are never published.

disputes.heading: Disputes
disputes.body: Complaints are reviewed by a human. The platform does not guarantee item quality and is not liable for agreements between parties.
